summary: Completed backend testing for salary increment, account lifecycle, attendance, and project financial privacy features. All 24 tests passed successfully with 100% success rate.
passed_tests: #4 Salary Increment: POST /api/employees/{eid}/salary/increment with apply_now=true - Creates salary history entry with delta_net
#4 Salary Increment: Invalid effective_date returns 400 as expected
#4 Salary History: GET /api/employees/{eid}/salary/history returns current + history sorted newest-first
#4 Payment History: GET /api/payroll/runs?employee_id={eid} returns list of payroll runs with breakdown snapshots
#5 Account Lifecycle: POST /api/employees/{eid}/account creates tenant-scoped user with user_id
#5 Account Lifecycle: Duplicate account creation returns 409 conflict
#5 Account Lifecycle: GET /api/employees/{eid}/account returns linked user info with user_id and role
#5 Account Lifecycle: POST /api/employees/{eid}/account/reset-password successfully resets password
#5 Account Lifecycle: POST /api/employees/{eid}/account/status successfully deactivates account (is_active=false)
#5 Account Permissions: Non-admin user gets 403 when trying to create account
#5 Tenant Isolation: Admin cannot create account for non-existent employee (404)
#2 Per-Employee Attendance: GET /api/attendance/monthly returns rows with employee shift_start and name
#2 Monthly Sheet Permissions: Non-finance user (Employee role) gets 403 when accessing monthly sheet
#3 Project Financial Privacy: Admin sees can_view_financials=true and all financial fields (invoices, milestones, financials, budget)
#3 Project Financial Privacy: Non-finance user sees can_view_financials=false and financial fields are omitted

salary_increment_feature.notes: Salary increment endpoint correctly computes gross/net/ctc, appends to salary_history with delta_net vs previous, and updates emp.salary when apply_now=true. Invalid effective_date properly returns 400. Salary history endpoint returns current + history sorted newest-first and requires employees.read permission.

payment_history_feature.notes: Payroll runs endpoint correctly filters by employee_id and returns payroll runs with breakdown snapshots preserved. Requires payroll.read permission.

account_lifecycle_feature.notes: Account creation for employees works correctly: creates tenant-scoped user linked via user_id, rejects duplicate email with 409, enforces Admin-only access (403 for non-admins). Password reset endpoint works and invalidates sessions. Account status toggle successfully deactivates accounts. All endpoints properly return 404 for non-existent employees.

tenant_isolation.notes: Tenant isolation verified: Admin cannot access employees from other tenants (employee lookup is tenant-scoped via sdb, returns 404 for cross-tenant access attempts).

per_employee_late_calc.notes: Code review confirms check-in late calculation uses employee's own shift_start and grace_minutes via _emp_shift_start() and _emp_grace() helpers, falling back to common policy when employee has none. Monthly sheet endpoint includes employee shift_start in response.

monthly_sheet_permissions.notes: Monthly attendance sheet correctly requires employees.read OR attendance.update/approve permissions. Normal employee without these permissions gets 403 as expected.

project_financial_privacy.notes: Project financial privacy correctly implemented: Admin/Finance users (with finance.read or invoices.read) see can_view_financials=true and all financial fields (invoices, milestones, purchase_orders, vendor_bills, financials, budget). Non-finance users see can_view_financials=false and financial fields are omitted from response. Data is not deleted, only omitted.

cleanup_status: All test resources (employees, users, projects) successfully cleaned up after testing
